D: A family's quiet lake holiday is wrecked when the rich, loud brother-in-law and his family turn up.
P: Serve the main when Roman takes on the Old 96er.
S: Lakeside crumbed fish bites with tartare
Panko crumbed flathead bites with homemade tartare sauce

Bite-size pieces of flathead in crisp panko crumbs, fried golden and served with a homemade caper and pickle tartare and lemon wedges. Cut 500g flathead fillets into 3cm pieces. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs. Shallow fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. For the tartare, mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.
Wisconsin lake country, where Chet only wanted a quiet week

Squeaky cheese curds in a light crisp batter, fried golden and served hot with ranch. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp sweet paprika and 1 tsp salt with 1 egg and 250ml cold soda water. Dip 500g cheese curds or cubed mild cheddar in the batter and fry in batches at 180C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with 150ml ranch dressing.
500g cheese curds or mild cheddar, cubed@Dairy
M: Big rump steak with garlic butter, onion rings, roast potatoes, ranch wedge

A huge chargrilled rump sliced to share, with garlic butter, crispy roast potatoes, onion rings and a wedge salad with ranch. Rub a 1.5kg piece of rump steak with oil and salt. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Grill the steak over high heat for 8 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest 10 minutes. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves. Bake 400g frozen onion rings for 15 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into wedges and drizzle with ranch. Slice the steak thickly, pour over the garlic butter and serve.
Roman's big shot barbecue chicken with potato salad
Roman insists on paying, then tells you what it cost

Chicken marylands brushed with smoky barbecue sauce and grilled over the coals, with a creamy dill potato salad. Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and cool a little. Toss the potatoes with the mayonnaise, sour cream, spring onion, chopped dill and salt. Rub the chicken with paprika and salt and grill over medium coals, turning, until nearly cooked. Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Serve with the potato salad.
W: Blueberry pie with a lemon scented filling and pastry crust

A jammy blueberry pie with lemon zest in a golden flaky crust, sprinkled with sugar and served warm with vanilla ice cream. Toss 750g frozen blueberries with 120g caster sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and the zest and juice of 1 lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill with the berries. Cover with a second sheet, crimp the edges and cut 4 slits on top. Brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling. Cool 30 minutes and serve with ice cream.
Toasted marshmallow, chocolate and caramel sandwiched between biscuits

Toasted marshmallows and squares of milk chocolate sandwiched between crunchy graham-style biscuits, with a dark chocolate and salted caramel version too. Lay 16 plain sweet wheatmeal biscuits on a lined tray. Top 8 of them with a square of milk chocolate and the other 8 with dark chocolate and a little caramel sauce. Thread 16 large marshmallows onto skewers and toast over a fire or gas flame until golden, or grill on the tray for 1 to 2 minutes. Put 2 marshmallows on each chocolate biscuit and press another biscuit on top. Eat while warm and melting.
K: Root beer over vanilla ice cream with a cocktail cherry

Ice-cold root beer poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams up, served in frosty mugs with a cherry on top. Chill 4 large mugs or glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Slowly pour cold root beer down the side until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up, about 300ml per mug. Add a cocktail cherry to each and serve straight away with straws and long spoons.
